metadata.title: Vietnam MT / Graduate / Internship successful-candidate public-source crawl
metadata.supplement_note: Expanded after parallel verification added detailed Central Retail, Shopee, Grab, L'Oréal, Unilever, Suntory PepsiCo, Nestlé and Masan profiles.
metadata.scope: Publicly indexed LinkedIn posts and public Vietnamese career/interview blogs only; no private groups or authenticated content
metadata.missing_value_policy: null means the source did not state the fact; values were not inferred from job title, school reputation, or company requirements
metadata.university_tier_policy: Only explicitly named universities are recorded. university_tier is null because no objective tier taxonomy was supplied.
metadata.quote_policy: Short source-grounded excerpts only; Vietnamese excerpts are retained or translated compactly without changing meaning.
limitations: Acceptance announcements are self-presentational and usually omit GPA, failed attempts, and detailed selection timelines.
Public LinkedIn pages can show an interstitial, but each included post was publicly indexed with visible post text at research time.
Prior-role information shown beside LinkedIn posts reflects publicly indexed profile context at crawl time, not a full historical CV.
This is observational program intelligence, not evidence that any trait caused acceptance.
